test_is_connection_error: test the A2AExceptionCheckers.is_connection_error method to check if an error string indicates a connection issue
test_is_localhost_url: test the A2AExceptionCheckers.is_localhost_url method to check if a URL is a localhost or internal address
test_is_agent_card_error: test the A2AExceptionCheckers.is_agent_card_error method to check if an error string indicates an agent card error
map_a2a_exception: map an A2A SDK exception to a LiteLLM A2A exception type such as A2ALocalhostURLError, A2AConnectionError, A2AAgentCardError, or A2AError
handle_a2a_localhost_retry: handle an A2ALocalhostURLError by fixing the agent card URL and creating a new A2A client for retry
